_doc: Lean attempts (Goedel header) for the warm-Lean checker (D37): each one is checked by a fresh `lean --json` and by the warm LSP checker; messages, verdict and model feedback must be identical. `strict` = checked with the axiom probe. `expect` = the fresh verdict on lean-prover49 (v4.9.0-rc1). Order matters: `leak_*` attempts check that nothing declared by a previous attempt survives into the next one.

attempts.body:
theorem w_omega (a b : ℕ) (h : a < b) : a + 1 ≤ b := by
  omega

theorem w_norm (x : ℝ) (hx : x = 2) : x ^ 2 + 1 = 5 := by
  subst hx
  norm_num

theorem w_lin (x : ℝ) (h : 0 < x) : 0 < x ^ 2 := by
  linarith

theorem w_nlin (x y : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = 0) : x = 0 := by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y]

lemma w_helper_leak (n : ℕ) : n + 0 = n := by simp

theorem w_leak_a (n : ℕ) : n + 0 = n := by
  exact w_helper_leak n

theorem w_leak_b (n : ℕ) : n + 0 = n := by
  exact w_helper_leak n

theorem w_unknown (a b : ℕ) : a + b = b + a := by
  exact Nat.add_comm_nonexistent a b

theorem w_exact (a b : ℕ) : a + b = b + a := by
  exact Nat.add_comm a b

theorem w_parse (a : ℕ) : a = a := by
  rfl
 theorem

theorem w_unsolved (p q : Prop) (hp : p) (hq : q) : p ∧ q := by
  constructor
  exact hp

theorem w_sorry (n : ℕ) : n * 0 = 0 := by
  sorry

theorem w_astral (f : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ) (h : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (𝓝 l)) : (𝓝 l) = (𝓝 (l + 0)) := by
  exact h

theorem w_multi (a b c : ℕ) (h₁ : a ≤ b) (h₂ : b ≤ c) : a ≤ c := by
  have h₃ : a ≤ c := by
    calc a ≤ b := h₁
      _ ≤ c := h₁
  exact h₃

theorem w_decide : (17 : ℕ) % 5 = 2 := by
  decide

theorem w_simp (a b : ℕ) (h : a = b) : a + 0 = b := by
  simp
  simp

set_option maxRecDepth 2000 in
theorem w_opt (a : ℤ) : a * 1 = a := by
  ring

open Finset in
theorem w_open (n : ℕ) : ∑ i in range n, (0 : ℕ) = 0 := by
  simp

set_option maxHeartbeats 200 in
theorem w_heart (x y z : ℝ) (h : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2 = 0) : x = 0 := by
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg z, sq_nonneg (x + y), sq_nonneg (y + z)]
theorem w_statement (n : ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ n) : n ! ≥ n := by sorry
theorem w_statement_bad (n : ℕ) : n ≥ undefined_thing := by sorry

theorem w_classical (p : Prop) : p ∨ ¬p := by
  exact Classical.em p

theorem w_axioms_ok (p : Prop) : p ∨ ¬p := w_classical p
